This article provides a short example of preprocessing, Bayesian covariate
screening, mixed-effects fitting, and diagnostics using **PharmaStatsR**.

```{r, fig.alt="Simulated observed responses against mixed-effects fitted values."}
library(PharmaStatsR)

# using the example dataset bundled with the package
data(pharmo_example)

# introduce a missing value and impute with KNN model
pharmo_example$WT[1] <- NA
covariates <- c("WT", "AGE", "CRCL")
imp <- impute_ml(
  pharmo_example, c("WT", "AGE"),
  k = 5, predictors = covariates
)

# Bayesian screening
sel <- screen_covariates_bayesian(imp, "DV", c("WT", "AGE", "CRCL"), min_bf = 3)

# fit and create a diagnostic plot
model <- fit_covariate_model(imp, "DV", "SubjectID", sel)
plot_obs_vs_pred(model, imp)
```
